title: GEMglLightModelf

messages.description: value to set the lighting model parameter to

arguments.description: value to set the lighting model parameter to

body: [GEMglLightModelf] calls glLightModelf() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. GL constants are numbers here: [GLdefine] turns a name like GL_LINES into its value. See glLightModel in the OpenGL reference.
